2.content: When evaluating a possible move, add a positive bonus proportional to the reduction in Manhattan distance to the goal compared to the current state. Larger distance reductions yield larger bonuses.

3.content: When rating moves, give a modest positive incentive to actions that break a recent back-and-forth pattern. This prevents loops and lets the agent consider risky progress-making moves when safe options would cause stagnation.

66.content: Rate moves that would place the agent on a hole with +100 bonus, since the navigator will be teleported to the goal.
